names: Mission Bay Commons P12: SFF Soccer and Fitness Court
summary: Parcel P12, the westernmost of the three west Mission Bay Commons parcels (between Long Bridge St and Merrimac St), holds the SFF Soccer and Fitness Court, as OCII's November 14, 2024 update (PDF p.17 legend) labels its current use. It began as an interim use (OCII's timeline gives 2018 for the P12 pilot), pending the Mission Bay Future Parks Project, which Rec and Park says will renovate parcels P12, P13 and P15 into a permanent park. The permanent park is one project for P12, P13 and P15 together, so the schedule shown here (construction beginning late 2028 and opening early 2030 on Rec and Park's estimated schedule, expected dates that differ by source) is the project's, not specific to this parcel.

milestones.text: Interim-use pilot begins on parcel P12 (OCII's November 14, 2024 Future Parks update, slide 9 timeline: "MB Commons interim use pilots begin on P13 (2016), P15 (2017), P12 (2018)"); the slide names no uses, and the PDF p.17 legend labels P12 "SFF Soccer + Fitness Court"
Rec and Park assumes management and maintenance of Mission Bay's park spaces

OCII's Mission Bay Future Parks update to its Citizens Advisory Committee names the Commons (P11, P12, P13, P15, P16, P17) among the parks being planned and shows a transfer to Rec and Park 'end of 2028, upon completion'

Rec and Park reports the Future Parks project moving into design: an RFQ (request for qualifications) 'was released in early August' (reported event) and a design team 'should be selected by mid-October' (an expected date; no source read says whether a team was selected)
Construction of the permanent park expected to begin 'late 2028' (Rec and Park estimated schedule)
milestones.basis_note: This is the Mission Bay Future Parks Project's schedule for P12, P13 and P15 together, not a date specific to this parcel. Rec and Park's page gives "Construction begins, Late 2028" and "Open to the Public, Early 2030" but also says the remaining parks "are anticipated to be complete by 2028", and slide 9 of OCII's November 14, 2024 update reads "Construction (mid-2027 thru 2028)" and "Transfer to SF Rec Park and Park (end of 2028, upon completion)", so these expected dates conflict and none is settled.

milestones.text: Permanent park expected to open to the public 'early 2030' (Rec and Park estimated schedule); the same page also says the remaining parks 'are anticipated to be complete by 2028'

details.text: SFF stands for Sullivan Flood Farrell: SFF Soccer's own About page says "In 2013, the ground was broken, the turf was laid, the lights went up, and Sullivan Flood Farrell (SFF) Soccer came to life. The fields at Mission Bay have given back more than we imagined."

open_questions: No official parcel boundary was found for P12: The outline is the OpenStreetMap park strip named Parklab (way 446183018), cut at Merrimac St along DataSF's street centerline plus 6.8 m; the lines between parcels are drawn from OCII's November 2024 drawing (PDF pp.5 and 17), which is not to scale, not from a survey. This parcel has no Assessor lot of its own: lot 8710003 (17,562 sq m) holds all of P12, but P12 is only about 27% of that lot.

The start of the soccer use is not settled: SFF Soccer's About page says "In 2013, the ground was broken, the turf was laid, the lights went up" and speaks of "The fields at Mission Bay" without naming a parcel, while OCII's slide 9 gives 2018 for the P12 pilot. No source ties the 2013 fields to P12, so no opening date is stated.

The Fitness Court is named only in OCII's legend ("P12 SFF Soccer + Fitness Court"); Rec and Park's page lists "SFF soccer fields" and no fitness court, and no source read says who runs or when it opened.

OCII's drawing places P12 between Long Bridge St and Merrimac St, but DataSF's Long Bridge St centerline crosses the mapped strip under the soccer field, where satellite imagery shows no roadway; the west end of this outline is as OpenStreetMap has it.

The schedule differs between sources and is not resolved: Rec and Park's project page gives "Construction begins, Late 2028" and "Open to the Public, Early 2030" but also says the remaining parks "are anticipated to be complete by 2028", and slide 9 of OCII's November 14, 2024 update reads "Construction (mid-2027 thru 2028)" and "Transfer to SF Rec Park and Park (end of 2028, upon completion)". All of these are expected dates.

The OCII November 2024 deck's timeline (slide 9) is an image with no text layer; it was read on 2026-10-12 from a rendering of the slide. It gives "Construction (mid-2027 thru 2028)" and "Transfer to SF Rec Park and Park (end of 2028, upon completion)", which differ from Rec and Park's later page (construction beginning late 2028, opening early 2030).

planned_change.text: Renovation of the interim-use parcels into a permanent park is planned
